unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: Figure 3 is an image plot and the extracted XML/PDF text gives exact survival values only for the 3.125 µg kg-1 bw group and long-survivor subset, not every plotted dose.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking for publication-grade review because primary activity tables 2-3 and the text-supported survival values capture the source-supported antimalarial endpoints; exact visual bar heights were not fabricated.
